tutorial.action: Press [M] to open Curriculum Expedition Map; move mouse to explore
tutorial.goal: Review 10 escape chambers training 15 systems thinking competencies
tutorial.astra: Welcome, educator. Ten ancient chambers await, each embodying a core systems thinking discipline.

tutorial.action: Navigate with [W][A][S][D], aim with mouse, press [E] / Click on beacons
tutorial.goal: Restore dynamic equilibrium in each room to unlock the exit portal
tutorial.astra: Every room responds to your choices. Locate the beacons, test hypotheses, and stabilize the system.

tutorial.action: Press [W] to approach central dais marked by cyan beacon; aim mouse
tutorial.goal: Diagnose system imbalance: reservoir stock drains without compensatory inflow
tutorial.astra: Notice how the reservoir depletes. Before regulating flow, we must delineate the system boundary.

tutorial.action: Aim reticle at Handwheel -> Press [E] or Left Click to rotate
tutorial.goal: Widen boundary radius from 2.2m to 3.2m (Integrity rises from 67% to 100%)
tutorial.astra: Widening the boundary brings soil moisture and the garden bed into the system, while the bell and birdsong stay outside.

tutorial.action: Turn right to Inflow Lever -> Press [E] to engage fluid valve
tutorial.goal: Equate inflow and outflow rates; stock stabilizes at target (70 units)
tutorial.astra: Match the inflow to the 6.0 outflow: when the two flows are equal the stock stops moving.

tutorial.action: Walk forward through the illuminated arch corridor into the warp portal
tutorial.goal: Transit through the unsealed portal to Room 2: Hall of Scale
tutorial.astra: Chamber complete! The airlock has unsealed. Step into the portal when ready.

tutorial.action: Navigate left toward the scale console using [W][A] and mouse
tutorial.goal: Diagnose false equivalence: comparing discrete units vs continuous magnitudes
tutorial.astra: Systems operate across multiple scales. We must distinguish discrete counts from continuous volume.

tutorial.action: Aim reticle at Deceptive Cube -> Press [E] to count discrete volume elements
tutorial.goal: Categorize unit dimensions; prevent false equivalences between dimensions
tutorial.astra: Categorical classification prevents false equivalences between unlike dimensions.

tutorial.action: Aim at Plunger -> Press [E] to reject comparing unlike units (cm² vs cm)
tutorial.goal: Scale balance tilts into alignment; Measurement Coherence reaches 120 Units
tutorial.astra: Measurement coherence verified! Never compare surface area directly with linear length.

tutorial.action: Walk forward through the unsealed doorway into the airlock warp portal
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 3: River of Relationships
tutorial.astra: Scale Coherence verified! The exit doorway has opened.

tutorial.action: Walk toward the Mediator Node altar in the glowing causal river using [W]
tutorial.goal: Diagnose network break: variables A and C are disconnected without intermediary B
tutorial.astra: In complex networks, direct causation is rare. We need to identify intermediary variables.

tutorial.action: Aim reticle at Mediator Crystal -> Press [E] to bridge disconnected variables
tutorial.goal: Indirect chains mediate closed feedback loops and establish system connectivity
tutorial.astra: The mediator node bridges the gap, allowing systemic feedback to propagate.

tutorial.beat: BEAT 3/4 · FIX THE POLARITY, THEN PULSE
tutorial.target: Outflow → Stock Polarity Badge [over the river, X = +3.8m] & Pulse Staff [X = +1.5m]
tutorial.action: Aim at the hexagonal badge reading [+] -> Press [E] to flip it to [−]; then aim at the Pulse Staff -> Press [E]
tutorial.goal: More outflow means less stock: the Outflow → Stock thread is balancing (−). At 100% coherence the pulse resonates
tutorial.astra: More outflow means less stock. Mark that thread minus, then send the pulse.

tutorial.action: Network Equilibrium achieved! Walk forward into the airlock warp portal
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 4: Echo Forest
tutorial.astra: Network Equilibrium locked! The river flows in smooth laminar harmony.

tutorial.action: Walk forward into the living root network using [W][A][S][D]
tutorial.goal: Diagnose systemic lag: actions take effect with delayed feedback, causing overshoot
tutorial.astra: Cause and effect are separated in time. If you ignore delays, you will overshoot the goal.

tutorial.target: Rotary Delay Dial [Right Root Trunk, X = +2.2m]
tutorial.action: Aim at Rotary Delay Dial -> Press [E] to calibrate lag compensation (+1.5s)
tutorial.goal: Damp phase lag; align sensor readings with delayed physical nutrient absorption
tutorial.astra: Compensating for delay eliminates wild oscillations before they destabilize the forest.

tutorial.target: Damping Ward Crystal [Deep Canopy Pedestal, Z = -6.0m]
tutorial.action: Aim at central Damping Ward Crystal -> Press [E] to absorb runaway pulse
tutorial.goal: Damping reinforcing loop restores balance; Ecosystem Stability reaches 142
tutorial.astra: Exponential explosion curbed! The canopy flourishes in sustained equilibrium.

tutorial.action: Canopy bridge active! Walk through the airlock transit corridor into the portal
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 5: Valley of Time
tutorial.astra: Canopy ecosystem stabilized! The transit bridge has raised.

tutorial.action: Walk forward to the temporal timeline console marked by the amber beacon using [W]
tutorial.goal: Diagnose path dependency: past accumulation locks future trajectories into place
tutorial.astra: Time is non-linear in systems. Past stock accumulations dictate future path dependency.

tutorial.action: Aim at Scrubber Handle -> Press [E] / Click & drag to project system states
tutorial.goal: Forecasting reveals critical tipping points and delayed accumulation curves
tutorial.astra: Scrubbing the timeline reveals tipping points hidden in short-term data.

tutorial.action: Aim at the Chronos Lens -> Press [E] to project how past accumulations lock future resilience
tutorial.goal: Trajectory resilience verified at 100%; the Trajectory Reservoir then has to reach 90 units
tutorial.astra: Resilience secured! The system can now absorb unexpected environmental shocks.

tutorial.action: Temporal equilibrium locked! Walk forward through the airlock corridor into portal
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 6: Prism Mountain
tutorial.astra: Temporal stability achieved! Proceed through the unsealed archway.

tutorial.action: Approach the optical perspective prism on the mountain summit using [W]
tutorial.goal: Diagnose stakeholder misalignment: pupil, teacher, and policymaker perspectives diverge
tutorial.astra: No single stakeholder sees the whole system. We must refract perspectives to find alignment.

tutorial.action: Aim at Prism -> Press [E] three times: Teacher, Designer and Pupil views, each with its own concern
tutorial.goal: Refracting pupil, teacher, and curriculum designer viewpoints
tutorial.astra: Each facet reveals a valid mental model. Watch the optical beams bend.

tutorial.target: Multi-Faceted Prism [Summit Dais] -> beams converge on the Receptor [Doorway Lintel, Z = -11.4m]
tutorial.action: Align refracted perspective beams squarely onto the rear convergence target
tutorial.goal: Perspective Synthesis reaches 100%! Stakeholder convergence completes optical circuit
tutorial.astra: Three concerns, one system. When all perspectives converge, the true systemic leverage emerges.

tutorial.action: Spectral gate unlocked! Walk forward through the airlock corridor into the portal
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 7: Garden of Models
tutorial.astra: Perspective Synthesis locked! The spectral airlock has unsealed.

tutorial.action: Move toward the living fractal bonsai tree model; the orange beacon marks its noise branches [W]
tutorial.goal: Diagnose over-complication: excessive descriptive detail obscures core feedback loops
tutorial.astra: All models are wrong, but some are useful. We must prune noise to reveal essence.

tutorial.action: Aim reticle at a noise branch (not a core variable) -> Press [E] to prune it; "Spurious Trend" is pruned the same way
tutorial.goal: Eliminating extraneous detail highlights the core feedback loops governing behavior
tutorial.astra: Pruning extraneous variables clarifies the feedback structure.

tutorial.beat: BEAT 3/4 · PRUNE THE SECOND NOISE BRANCH, THEN THE DIAL
tutorial.target: "Spurious Trend" Branch [Bonsai Tree, 4.9m up] -> Abstraction Dial [Front Console, Center, Z = -2.0m]
tutorial.action: Look up to "Spurious Trend" -> Press [E] to prune it; then turn to the Abstraction Dial (tier 3, over-complex) -> Press [E] to turn it down to tier 2
tutorial.goal: Goal: both noise branches gone, core variables kept, tier 2 chosen — Model Adequacy at 110 units
tutorial.astra: One noise variable left: prune it, keep the three core variables, then turn the dial down to the economical tier.

tutorial.action: Model validated! Walk forward through the airlock transit corridor into portal
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 8: The Seed of Change
tutorial.astra: Parsimonious model validated! The portal is open.

tutorial.action: Move forward toward the high-leverage seed pedestal using [W]
tutorial.goal: Diagnose leverage levels: adjusting parameters has low impact; structural shifts transform systems
tutorial.astra: Donella Meadows taught us: small changes at the root produce massive system-wide transformation.

tutorial.action: Aim at the Golden Seed -> Press [E] or Left Click to acquire intervention catalyst
tutorial.goal: Identifying high-leverage paradigm shifts over low-leverage parameter tweaks
tutorial.astra: Catalyst acquired! Now identify where in the structural network this seed will have maximum leverage.

tutorial.action: Turn right to structural socket -> Press [E] to insert seed at system root
tutorial.goal: Systemic Leverage Amplification reaches 150%! Structural matrix transforms
tutorial.astra: Structural transformation cascading! The rules of the system have evolved.

tutorial.action: Structural transformation complete! Walk forward through airlock into Room 9
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 9: The Emergence Chamber
tutorial.astra: System transformed! Step into the unsealed airlock portal.

tutorial.action: Use [W] to approach the high-pressure pipeline network marked by the beacon
tutorial.goal: Diagnose complex emergence: local pipeline leaks trigger global pressure collapse
tutorial.astra: Emergence means the whole is greater than the sum of parts. Local leaks threaten global collapse.

tutorial.action: Aim reticle at leaking pipe -> Press [E] to clamp coupling and stop fluid loss
tutorial.goal: Preventing non-linear failure cascades: local leaks compromise global integrity
tutorial.astra: Coupling sealed! Halting fluid loss prevents catastrophic pressure drop.

tutorial.action: Look up at overhead Pressure Relief Valve -> Press [E] to vent excess accumulation
tutorial.goal: Systemic Integrity restored to 100%! Flow network returns to stable laminar regime
tutorial.astra: Pressure equalized! Laminar flow restored throughout the municipal grid.

tutorial.action: Industrial network stabilized! Walk forward into the final observatory portal
tutorial.goal: Transit to Room 10: Reflection Observatory
tutorial.astra: Network stabilized! Proceed to the final observatory chamber.

tutorial.action: Walk onto the central dais using [W] under the celestial galaxy dome
tutorial.goal: Metacognitive consolidation: reviewing growth across all 15 systems thinking competencies
tutorial.astra: Here in the observatory, we look back across the entire expedition and synthesize our learning.

tutorial.action: Aim at Digital Twin Console -> Press [E] to inspect learning telemetry and passport
tutorial.goal: Synthesizing biometric composure, decision latency, and mental model refinement
tutorial.astra: Your digital twin reflects your composure, decision speed, and systems mastery.

tutorial.action: Aim at Metacognitive Synthesis Crystal -> Press [E] to synchronize all 10 chambers
tutorial.goal: All 15 Arnold & Wade systems competencies illuminate across the celestial dome
tutorial.astra: Every loop, stock, delay, and perspective now resonates in perfect harmony.

tutorial.action: Living Mathematics Ecosystem mastered! Walk forward into the infinite horizon portal
tutorial.goal: EduGenZ ASTE Serious Game fully verified and ready for classroom intervention
tutorial.astra: Congratulations! You are now an embodied systems thinker ready to transform education.
